name: inertia-capacitor-shell
description: Capacitor native shell (iOS + Android) loading the full INERTIA web app

scripts.sync: npm run config && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:android: npm run config && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run config && npx cap sync ios
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.prepare:icons: npm run build:icon && npm run generate:assets && node scripts/patch-android-adaptive-icon.js && npm run copy:icons
